_comment: Source of truth for the Page 1 central registry table in Asana Knowledge. Exists because Asana's page_get API can never read a <table>'s content back (only a placeholder line) — so the table's real rows must live here, not be reconstructed from Asana. Every asana-skill-changelog run must: 1) fetch the latest copy of this file from GitHub, 2) upsert this skill's row here, 3) render the FULL table from every row here and page_update Page 1 with it, 4) commit+push this file back to GitHub so the next run (possibly a different session) has the current full state. Never write a partial table to Page 1 from a stale copy of this file.

rows.what_it_does: แปลง requirement เป็น prototype พร้อม presentation mode — Asana-backed sibling ของ ds-governance-prototype-notion, Core DS เป็น base เสมอ, เลือก project-layer mode ได้ 3 แบบ (Core only / Existing project DS / Core + new composed layer), รองรับ compare toggle อิสระ 3 ตัว (Design System / Branding / Tone of Voice)
